mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above a 5% month-over-month growth rate signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below a 1% month-over-month growth rate signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above a 3% month-over-month growth rate signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS MoM > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a potential monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.
